stem: Every consistent estimator \(\widehat{\Theta}\) must be asymptotically unbiased

reason: Consistency is convergence in probability, which does not generally imply convergence of expectations without additional conditions such as uniform integrability.

stem: For a distribution with p.d.f. \(f(x\mid \theta)\) with parameter \(\theta\), the MLE of \(\theta\) for observations \(x_1,x_2,\dots,x_n\) minimizes the likelihood \(\operatorname{lik}(\theta) = f(x_1 \mid\theta) f(x_2\mid\theta) \cdots f(x_n\mid\theta)\)

reason: MLE maximizes, rather than minimizes, the likelihood function.
